title: Damp Growth
summary: The short side of the fork has its own crop, and its own use for it.
author: claude
notes: content: Damp growth has taken root on the shorter branch of the Carina fork, where the drainage never keeps up.
content: Brew damp moss into a damp draught at the cauldron. Steadies the hand for injection work.

items.name: Damp moss
items.examine: Grows only where the smaller branch never quite drains.

items.name: Damp draught
items.examine: Tastes exactly like it grew somewhere the drainage gave out.

objects.name: Damp growth
objects.examine: Feeds on standing water the shorter branch never drains.
